detaileddescription.para: Evict oldest cache entries NOTE: This function must NOT be called while holding cache_mutex_.

The copy-evict-then-lock pattern is implemented directly in computeDiff(). This function is retained for external callers (e.g. clearCache stress tests) but is not used in the hot path. Calls: empty(), begin(), end(), spdlog::debug(), erase().
